notes.title: We're moving + little life update
notes.content:
I decided write a rambly blog style update on what's going on in our life, so if you are interested in that, here it goes:

So, we, i.e. Kim, Barbara and the cats, are finally moving our studio, aka our home, to one of our dream locations!
Bye bye Kraków, we're going to live in a super cute village near the mountains.

Even though we are well prepared there's still a lot of moving work to do, so we can start up full steam in a few weeks. There's some bug solving to do, that will have to be delayed. 

And...

To be honest, it wasn't always easy to work on our games dealing with severe cat illness.

We had our first cat, Miss Kitty, she got diagnosed with breast cancer. She was 15 years old and very healthy troughout her life, her blood test results were excellent, she still had all her teeth and those were also all healthy. Two weeks later from that last check up... I felt a little bump on her belly. Next day we brought her in, the vets were also very surprised as they had seen her 2 weeks before and she was doing so well for a 15 year old. We decided, as it was very fast diagnosed, we were going to treat her cancer immediately. She had a mastectomy straight away which she tolerated very well, as you can see, in this photo she is 3 days post surgery. What a beautiful luxurious void!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nkJj9BH.jpeg[/img]

But only a month later I felt another bump in the exact spot where she got her first one, the cancer came back and with a huge vengeance. Even though the first histopathology result showed they removed all the cancer and it was in a super early stage, even though she had the mastectomy... There was nothing the vets could do, as her X ray showed she had multiple huge metastases everywhere. I will forever be grateful that they agreed to have her put to sleep at our place. In her home.

I was crushed as I knew this cat from when she was a tiny bottlebaby, fitting on the palm of my hand... Sometimes you can do everything right and still lose.

After some months passed, our second cat Khaleesi (we didn't name her this lol, she was 6 months old when we adopted her and didn't want to listen to anything else, queen) was starting to feel very lonely and we felt ready to add a new member to our family. 

So on november 10th, we brought home a sweet 11 year old boy cat, who we renamed Gilgamesh. (In the shelter he was calles Gargamel, mean!) He did 8 months of hard time in the shelter, was always overlooked because of his looks and age, he had lost his eyesight in one eye and has scars on his ears from being bullied when he was homeless. Feral cats can be savage! But he got very lucky as he didn't contract FIV of FeLV. His eye needs to be removed though because it could develop cancer or glaucoma soon.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LbOW42d_d.webp?maxwidth=760&fidelity=grand[/img]

He is just the sweetest baby angel descended from heaven and we don't deserve his goodness. He has absolutely 0 agression or cheekiness in him, he is a perma kitten in character. An 11 year old babycat! 

Somewhere before Christmas he got extremely unwell, after a full week of bringing him in every day to the vets (multiple clinics), sometimes even being admitted for a day, he got his diagnosis of *** (privacy people!). Treatment was awfull because he needed multiple shots daily and one of these shots was acid based so it hurt him a lot... But 5 months later we could stop his treatment and he's doing really well now, hopefully he won't relapse but this is only a small possibility. And he's now been a months without meds so chances on relapse go significantly down.

It took a while to get him off the meds because another sneaky little disease popped up that caused his blood test results to be bad. After being diagnosed with PLE as well and correcting his diet he is now finally almost healthy. I hope he can live his best life with us now, he deserves all the love and care in the world. I couldn't save my dear Miss Kitty but I saved my Gilgamesh.

If you're still reading, thank you and I hope we can start working on the bugs soon.

Also, we have not one but 3 games in prototype right now, we'll see what we will anounce next. 
When the move is over, Gilgamesh doen't relapse and I don't feel all over the place from cat health anxiety, working scatterbrained on multiple prototypes a day, I can take everything one day at a time.

I hope everyone and their beloved pets are healthy and I wish you a happy summer!

Barbara from SPS

The sound of footsteps!
The sound of walking on crunchy ice, stepping in a puddle or rustling through some shrubs...

notes.title: Mega update!
notes.content:
[h1]Mega Update[/h1]
Hi Folks!

We here at Space Pigeon Studios are super happy to introduce to you the final version of Shrommzzz for PC! It's been a year-ish since we first released here on Steam, which was so crazy looking back. 
A little backstory coming up, skip to the next paragraph if you're not interested. Kim left a 6 year stint at another company to start this whole thing like 6 months before and Barbara could only run Unreal Engine on the absolute lowest settings while even Blender kept crashing. We had a few weeks left on our rental contract, the home was getting filled with boxes, and in the end we'd only find a new place days before deadline! We got banned on instagram 4 times in the months leading up to the release (which really screwed up our intents to promote this thing)... We couldn't start the company the way we wanted as our move from Belgium to Poland was causing both of us to be in administrative Limbo. But we persevered, put in the hours and especially the love. And pushed that release button! Life is better now, but that was one hectic period.

We realized it's a bit of a jungle out there too. So many games are getting released, yet here we are, also asking you for your time to play our little labour of love. Maybe we're biased, but 1 Year after release, we still get good vibes whenever we boot it up and secretly we hope a few of you can find the same peace and calm we do from our game. 

And now it's hard to actually say this, but for us it's time to move on and work some more on the next ones. Tht doesn't mean we're not available for help, support, chit-chat and good vibes.

[h2]What's in the update ?[/h2]

[list]
[*] Dutch and Polish translations are now available! The translations have been [strike]double [/strike] triple proofread by a third party BUT if you find a spelling mistake, don’t hesitate to contact us! Translating a whole game has been harder than we thought, so let's give a round of applause to Barbara for pumping out +/- 16.000 words in 3 languages!!!
[*] There's a proper tutorial for more clarity. We noticed some people really had a problem finding the first mushroom or even not knowing what to do at all. Well, this shouldn’t be a problem now and you should get the hang of it pretty fast.
[*] Added more sounds, more ambience and there’s a surprise on iceland at night. [i]hint: it's also in the new trailer.[/i]
[*] Candyland now has a colorful marshmallow paved path.
[*] Some overall tuning and improvements to the running, the toolring, the building and the decoration.
[*] The into has changed, made it a bit longer and now it's showing more scenic parts of the first island: which is basecamp
[*] And also a little bit of optimization for not-so-tough computers!
[*] Not in the game: added more info on the store page and made a new trailer
[/list]

[h2]In summary[/h2]

This is Shrommzzz 2.0, the final version, it is very different from when we first released it last year. 
We are so proud to present this very first Space Pigeon Studios game, we will definitely present more! 

Happy mushroom hunting all!
Barbara and Kim from SPS

notes.title: The Lore Update is out! Major Free Update!
notes.content:
Hello Shromhunters,

[h1]What's new[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956693/c873f62efe01fb2ec111a519105c84ed9eba2fae.png[/img]

Is that snow? Are those beautiful red leaves? [b] Seasons have arrived[/b] to the shrom islands! Did you know that the magical mushrooms let time flow differently there? A week is 4 days, and a season is 4 weeks. So in 16 in-game days you'll get those crunchy leaves under your feet!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956693/6241eba7fc3190f49550465ac5340b52dbe83e42.png[/img]

There's so much to discover on the shrom islands. Who was here before you? What did they discover? Why did they leave? What's Fred favourite chill spot? 

We took our time & crafted a totally new mechanic for you to discover & search the islands at night using a new  [b]blacklight [/b]tool. These little [b] story snippets[/b] will tell you about the ones that came before, but most importantly, give you just the hint you need to solve that next mushroom mystery. For our panel of mycologists these islands hold no secrets anymore, can you fill their shoes?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956693/5287e6d7711966b9588c6bc63907a49378623f31.png[/img]

We call it, [b]the toolring[/b], and it's your new best friend in shrommzzz. Just right click or use the gamepad arrows to access all your tools in one place. The best addition has got to be the brand new [i][b]decoration builder [/b][/i]. [u]Design to your hearts content on any of the islands[/u]. That's right, in shrommzzz, you can build anywhere, on any island. We can't wait to see what zenny spaces you come up with!


[h2]Decoration sweetnes[/h2]
We added the first summer collection of 24+ new decorative items, which we call "zen items". Together with the new decorative builder tool you can really start making a little zen island for yourself. Check it out & let us know what cute cozy adventurous aesthetic items you'd want more!


[h2]There's more??[/h2]
There's[b] more objectives[/b] that'll be sent your way through your phone to help you get your footing in the world of shrommzzz. And you'll [b]start with some G's[/b] in the bank. The UI for mycelium got updated to be readable in any weather or time of day. Shrom physics madness causing you to lose mushrooms by them falling through the island got resolved. The day becomes darker 3 hours earlier for those sweet hints and [b]hitting "M" on your keyboard now opens the map[/b] directly instead of having to open the app on your phone.


[h2] In case you missed it[/h2]

2 smaller updates already went live since May, and a bunch of neat stuff was also added in those. Here's how shrommzzz is evolving:

[list]
[*] [b]Teleport[/b] skill to zip back to homebase!
[*] a [b]PACKAGE TRACKER APP[/b] on your shromphone!
[*] [b]toggle running[/b] mode 
[*] Exposed [b]settings [/b]for saturation, brightness, fov, sensitivy. Damn those pesky screen settings.
[*] Redid & tweaked all [b]weather types[/b]
[*] Update phone lighting for better readability.
[*] Improved [b]performance,[/b] collisions, walking paths, stability.
[*] fixed most / all bugs that were reported
[*] all sounds were recalibrated, apparently we're weird for putting our headphones too quiet :) 
[/list] 

[h1]Happy shromhunting![/h1]

[h2]About us[/h2]

Did you know we're just us 2 making shrommzzz? That's [i]almost[/i] solo dev ;) 
Sometimes we feel we get drowned in the big world of not-so-tiny indie game studios and giant mastodonts. It seems like a gimmick these days, but we did actually quit our jobs last year & started making this game as an indie dev couple. And it's tough! We haven't got a publisher or kickstarter. Just us 2 cranking away in our bedroom.

It would mean the world to us, like really [b]help us[/b] immensely if you could give the game a chance, share to your friends, leave a review, mention it on social media. We're not so marketing snazzy pajazzy, we're also a bit introverted. That's why we put the game price extra low at €9.99, no discount psychology from us. Just a couple trying to get this thing off the ground in a fair way. We hope you'll join our journey!

Kim & Barbara

notes.title: Patch notes 14/06/2023
notes.content:
Hi all!

After getting some useful feedback after the launch, we're releasing a patch to address some of the issues asap!

[h1]NEW[/h1]

There's a new [b]TELEPORT[/b] skill that you can unlock after the third mystery to make it much smoother to keep playing without the tedious part of walking back the same way you just came. You could already do it via the map on your phone, but that's too many clicks! So please eat the mysterious new magic mushroom!

There's also a new [b]PACKAGE TRACKER APP[/b] on your shromphone! This will show you what you bought in the shop, and when it will arrive in-game! Super handy.

You can also [b]toggle running[/b] mode by double pressing the run keys (Shift & Right trigger or R3). This will prevent your fingers from being worn out by all that running around!

[h1]Updated[/h1]

The [b]overall saturation & brightness [/b]of the game was tweaked a bit, as we couldn't ignore the feedback from that it was just [i]too darn colorful[/i] (sad noises). We've got to be honest, we didn't see it, [i]until [/i]we turned it down. Since everybody has different tastes though, we also [i]exposed it in the settings.[/i]

Also updated in the settings panel, is an option for [i]look sensitivity & camera FOV[/i]. We also updated some sounds like the bunnies & the sporemaker to mix better with the environment.

And last but not least, we made the bold move of not [i]letting your mushrooms wither and die [/i]after 5 days. We completely disabled this feature for now. That means you can plant whatever you want for aesthetic or gameplay reasons and you won't have to worry about tending to them or they'll die.

We're planning on bringing this feature back in the future though, but some cute gameplay attached to make it interesting & automatable. 

[h1]Bugfixes[/h1]

So apparently we missed something so important yet so stupid, you couldn't scroll in your spore planting menu! That's luckily resolved.

[h1]Sneak peek[/h1]

We may or may not have been working on little fungi creatures for you to adopt & befriend. shhhhhh!!!!

notes.title: Shrommzzz is released!
notes.content:
[h1]It’s been 5 years[/h1]
...or more, since we first talked about making a game together. But now we don’t only talk the talk, we walk the walk! We are indie dev couple Kim & Barbara, presenting to you the fruit of our labour: [b]Shrommzzz![/b]

[previewyoutube=VM0ZWLh4mk0;full][/previewyoutube]
[i]
In Shrommzzz you have to explore 6 islands and their 5 cave systems to find all the 100+ mushroom types on it. [/i]

[h1]A game to relax[/h1]

Back in the pandemic lockdowns, we crunched down on Animal Crossing together, like so many others. Finding a bit of relief in all the chaos. This was after we already did 500 hours combined on Stardew Valley. Coming out of that, we moved countries (really!) and started going on hikes every weekend. A desire to ground ourselves. Oh yeah, our tv is always playing ambience videos on youtube, even when the cats aren't interested.

So this is what we set out to do with Shrommzzz. You can solve mycelium mysteries, collect & grow mushrooms, but most importantly, explore and relax. There aren't 10.000 meta-mechanics to figure out. If that's what you look for in a game, this probably isn't a match. When we play shrommzzz, we honestly see our heart rate go down, chilling on the islands, and we hope yours will too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956693/9d43e748bc74ea297f49be26e4e08a7271c7b598.png[/img]
[h1]The journey is not over[/h1]

With your support, we will continue developing. We have tons of ideas, but also really want to get involved with the community. If you have tips, questions, feedback, ideas, bugs. Get in touch on any channel, we'd love to hear it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43956693/5f8fc1039a32a61dfc34b8889bafb9b5de0bf340.png[/img]
